## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed sector returns (Tech, Healthcare, Consumer Staples, Energy positive vs Financials, Communication negative) and MAJOR divergence among large caps (NVDA, MA, ISRG showing 1W/1M sign differences) — treat as transitional, watch for clarity; Leadership: Mixed (3/5 Technology in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology lead names: AAPL (1W: +3.19% | 1M: +8.70%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +1.08% | 1M: +3.54%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +12.52%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare strong: TMO (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.85%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.40% | 1M: -1.95%) RECOVERY. Energy contributions: MPC (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +15.54%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +17.85%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Financials lag: GS (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -8.11%) BELOW TREND, BAC (1W: -7.00% | 1M: -8.96%) BELOW TREND. Communication weak: CMCSA (1W: -8.98% | 1M: -12.56%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -5.12% | 1M: -10.10%) BELOW TREND. Industrials and Consumer Discretionary also showing broad weakness (CAT, BA, HD all BELOW TREND).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PANW (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +0.25%) ABOVE TREND; TMO (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.85%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +12.52%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +8.24% | 1M: +12.53%) ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +15.54%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership concentration: Mixed (3/5 Technology); style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: LRCX (1W: -9.63% | 1M: -17.87%) BELOW TREND; CMCSA (1W: -8.98% | 1M: -12.56%) BELOW TREND; AMAT (1W: -8.06% | 1M: -18.76%) BELOW TREND; CEG (1W: -8.10% | 1M: -1.51%) BELOW TREND; SLB (1W: -7.02% | 1M: -1.62%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Semis/Comm and select Energy names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: PANW (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +0.25%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.85%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +12.52%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.24% | 1M: +12.53%) ABOVE TREND. Watchlist: NVDA (1W: +0.45% | 1M: -0.07%) RECOVERY and MA (1W: +0.06% | 1M: -1.49%) RECOVERY — major divergence signals, tactical not structural.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but positive on balance: AAPL (1W: +3.19% | 1M: +8.70%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +1.08% | 1M: +3.54%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +0.45% | 1M: -0.07%) RECOVERY, AMAT (1W: -8.06% | 1M: -18.76%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Technology positive this week (one of 4/11 sectors positive) — internal rotation with divergence between large caps and semis.

8. Financials Outlook?
Under pressure: GS (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -8.11%) BELOW TREND, BAC (1W: -7.00% | 1M: -8.96%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -1.20% | 1M: -3.84%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +1.56%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth: Financials weak this week (sector negative overall); style tilt away from banks given earnings/mark-to-market headlines.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed with select strength: TMO (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.85%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.40% | 1M: -1.95%) RECOVERY, CVS (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -4.89%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Healthcare positive this week (one of 4/11 sectors positive); watch divergence between device names and large-cap pharma.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to selective Technology and Energy names showing confirmed ABOVE TREND (AAPL, INTC, VLO, MPC) and monitor Healthcare RECOVERY setups (ISRG, LLY). Reduce exposure to weak Financials and Communication names showing BELOW TREND (GS, BAC, CMCSA). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; treat NVDA/MA/ISRG divergences as tactical opportunities, not broad conviction.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +12.52%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +17.85%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.85%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: GS (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -8.11%) BELOW TREND, BAC (1W: -7.00% | 1M: -8.96%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -9.63% | 1M: -17.87%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (MPC, VLO) — sector positive this week and earnings-driven. Healthcare (TMO, ISRG) — monitor clinical/approval headlines. BEARISH: Financials and Communication — weak breadth and large-cap bank pain; Industrials underperforming.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA 1W: +0.45% | 1M: -0.07% (RECOVERY) — watch for confirmation above near-term resistance to validate recovery. AAPL (1W: +3.19% | 1M: +8.70%) ABOVE TREND — watch for continuing leadership above recent pivot. GS (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -8.11%) BELOW TREND — failure to reclaim short-term support would deepen financials risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
MDT (+80): Medtronic outlook raise; price not in top lists here but monitor for confirmation with device names. VLO (+55): Surging estimates; VLO (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +17.85%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. ISRG (+55): EU nod for da Vinci SP; ISRG (1W: +6.40% | 1M: -1.95%) RECOVERY — sentiment aligns with price bounce.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BAC (-75): Unrealized bond loss headline; BAC (1W: -7.00% | 1M: -8.96%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed and a risk to Financials. GS (score bearish in data) — GS (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -8.11%) BELOW TREND — confirming weakness. BA (-45): production/cost pressure; BA (1W: -3.81% | 1M: -11.68%) BELOW TREND — headline risk confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. AAPL (1W: +3.19% | 1M: +8.70%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +25.50%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +12.52%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR divergence among large caps (NVDA RECOVERY, MA RECOVERY, ISRG RECOVERY) and weak Financials (BAC, GS) tied to negative sentiment — watch for trend confirmation before reallocating.
